verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no Snyk sandbox or test environment, such as a sandbox org or test tenant, that isolates experimentation from production data. The read-only CLI tester role, which blocks `snyk monitor`, is an adjacent permission control, not sandbox isolation. Local `snyk test` runs are scans, not an isolated environment, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
